title: 第9章 接连突破优化驱邪符第10章 吓傻九叔妖孽天赋
slug: 九叔系统道术给我全加满
content_zh:
“这……”
文才顿时被呛住，不由得心里更觉恐怖。
大师兄怎么一下子变这么厉害了？
以前感觉也就那样啊！
一旁的秋生，只是不做声，时不时望一眼林凡。
心里说不上来的泄气和羡慕。
以前总觉得，大师兄天赋就那样，可能还没自己强。
自己只是太懒惰了，只要努努力就能超过大师兄。
可现在呢？
差距瞬间巨大的无法望其项背。
这可是半步先天的妖啊！
换自己来，恐怕不用几秒钟就成尸体了！
可大师兄呢？
轻描淡写就斩杀了，甚至一副不值一提的平淡模样！
这差距未免太让人绝望了。
“都早些休息吧，这下是真没事了。”
林凡失笑，摆摆手道。
刚拿了功德，又可以优化了！
哪有时间在这长吁短叹的！
“走吧。”

九叔多看了林凡一眼，心里喜悦起来。
不再多言，领着三人一同往任家大堂去。
一行人还没来得进入任家大堂。
忽然，又是一道微微的妖气缭绕在空气之中！
“不对，还有！”
九叔眼神一闪，和林凡对视一眼。
文才和秋生还没反应过来。
只见两人已经往左侧的院子，飞驰而去！
……
左院，正房。
九叔和林凡一路飞驰。
随着残存的妖气，停在了一间富丽堂皇的房门前。
“任老爷的房间？”
九叔立刻认出了眼前的房间。
“进去看看再说。”
林凡没废话，和九叔一同上前。
吱嘎！
两人推开大门。
只见一身米白色睡衣的中年男子正闭目而行。
任老爷仿佛被迷了心智一般，浑然不知自己行径。

翻找着房内每个角落，地上布满书柜大大小小的储物盒。
只见床头柜旁一株散发着残存的一丝丝妖气枯萎了怪异红花！
“师父，应该是它了。”
content_en:
"This..."
Wencai was choked immediately, and he couldn't help but feel even more terrified.
How did the senior brother become so powerful all of a sudden?
It felt like that before!
Qiu Sheng on the side just kept silent and glanced at Lin Fan from time to time.
I felt indescribable frustration and envy.
I used to feel that my senior brother's talent was just that, maybe not as good as mine.
I'm just too lazy. As long as I work hard, I can surpass my senior brother.
But now?
The gap was instantly so huge that it was beyond compare.
This is a half-step innate demon!
If it were him, he would be a corpse in a few seconds!
But what about senior brother?
He was killed in an understatement, even with a bland look that was not worth mentioning!
This gap is too disappointing.
"Everyone should rest early. Everything will be fine now."
Lin Fan laughed and waved his hands.
I just got the merit and can optimize again!
There is no time to sigh like this!
"Let's go."
Uncle Jiu took another look at Lin Fan and felt happy.
Without further words, he led the three of them to the lobby of the Ren family.
The group of people had not yet entered the lobby of the Ren family.
Suddenly, there was another faint evil spirit lingering in the air!
"No, there's more!"
Uncle Jiu's eyes flashed and he looked at Lin Fan.
Wencai and Qiu Sheng haven't reacted yet.
I saw the two of them speeding away towards the yard on the left!
…
Left courtyard, main room.
Uncle Jiu and Lin Fan were speeding along.
Following the remaining evil spirit, it stopped in front of the door of a magnificent room.
"Master Ren's room?"
Uncle Jiu immediately recognized the room in front of him.
"Go in and take a look before we talk."
Lin Fan didn't waste any time and stepped forward with Uncle Jiu.
Squeak!
The two pushed open the door.
I saw a middle-aged man in off-white pajamas walking with his eyes closed.
Master Ren seemed to be obsessed with his mind and had no idea what he was doing.
After rummaging through every corner of the room, the floor was covered with bookcases, large and small storage boxes.
I saw a strange withered red flower next to the bedside table that exuded a trace of evil spirit!
"Master, this should be it."
